messages.plaintextBody:
James — unrelated to what you're on, but can you cover the bring-down call on the Crestview / Project Cedar acquisition on Friday at 3? Margaret Holloway's team want a status check before signing. Daniel Reeve will dial in. Thanks.

Sarah
